text.tspan: Share of one-year-olds who have been immunized against a disease or a pathogen.
Data source: WHO & UNICEF (2025); UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
Note: This includes diphtheria, pertussis and tetanus (3rd dose), measles (1st dose), hepatitis B (3rd dose), polio (3rd dose), Haemophilus
influenzae b (3rd dose), rubella (1st dose), rotavirus (final dose), pneumococcal vaccine (3rd dose), and inactivated polio (first dose).
